titel: Culture around Venray: museums and history | Hotel Asteria
omschrijving: Culture around Hotel Asteria in Venray: the Overloon War Museum, Museum Village De Locht, the Limburgs Museum, Arcen Castle Gardens and the Hertog Jan Brewery.
hero-sub: Museums about the war and village life, castle gardens and a brewery, a quarter of an hour to half an hour away.
hero-alt: Tank in the hall of the Overloon War Museum
intro-tekst: In the autumn of 1944 there was heavy fighting around Venray. In Overloon you'll learn more about it than anywhere else in the region. If you'd rather see everyday life from the past, head to Museum Village De Locht or the Limburgs Museum in Venlo. Arcen Castle Gardens and the Hertog Jan Brewery are on the same side of the Maas and fit nicely into one afternoon.
p1-regel: The Overloon War Museum is nine minutes' drive away.
p2-regel: Most museums are largely under cover.
p3-regel: Combine the brewery with the castle gardens.
p4-regel: Museum, dinner and an overnight stay in one go.
uitjes-sub: Sorted by drive time from Hotel Asteria.
arr-sub: An overnight stay, entry to the Overloon War Museum with coffee or tea in the museum, a three-course dinner and the breakfast buffet. You'll see the price for your dates when you book.
dag-sub: From breakfast to dinner, with a museum in the middle.
m1-tekst: Breakfast at the hotel, then a nine-minute drive to Overloon. Arrive early and the museum is still quiet.
m1-alt: Breakfast plate with croissant, cheese and cold cuts
m2-tekst: Allow a few hours for the halls of vehicles and the stories of local people. A cup of coffee in the museum is part of it.
m2-alt: Aircraft and vehicles in a hall of the Overloon War Museum
m3-naam: A quiet moment at the cemetery
m3-tekst: On the way back you pass the British war cemetery in Venray. A short stop that stays with you.
m3-alt: Rows of headstones at the war cemetery in Venray
m4-tekst: Back at the hotel, first the wellness area, then dinner in the brasserie.
m4-alt: A guest having dinner by the window
f1-v: Which museum is closest to the hotel?
f1-a: The Overloon War Museum, nine minutes by car. Museum Village De Locht in Melderslo is about a quarter of an hour away.
f2-v: How much time do I need for the Overloon War Museum?
f2-a: Allow half a day to a full day. The museum is large and there's plenty to read and see.
f3-v: Can I do the castle gardens and the brewery in one day?
f3-a: Yes. Arcen Castle Gardens and the Hertog Jan Brewery are both in Arcen, about 25 minutes from the hotel.
f4-v: Is there a package with a museum visit?
f4-a: Yes, the War Museum package: an overnight stay, museum entry with coffee or tea, a three-course dinner and the breakfast buffet.
f5-v: What can I do when it rains?
f5-a: The museums are a good choice in the rain. The Limburgs Museum in Venlo and the Overloon War Museum have plenty of indoor galleries.
f6-v: Do I need to buy tickets in advance?
f6-a: That depends on the museum and the season. Check the museum's website or ask reception.
meer-sub: There's more to do around Venray than museums alone.
slot-kop: After the museum, back to your room
slot-tekst: Book a room or the War Museum package and take your time with the stories of the region.
